permissions.view: See sheets and download blank worksheets
permissions.enter: Enter sheets - a photo of the paper sheet or typed in - check them and submit them for approval
permissions.approve: Approve or send back submitted sheets; approving posts the stock entry to ERPNext

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Sees sheets and downloads blank worksheets. The lowest level, given to anyone who has not been set up for Spoke Daily Input.

roles.name: Production
roles.description: Enters sheets - a photo of the paper sheet or typed in - checks them and submits them to the Head for approval.

roles.name: Head
roles.description: Everything production can do, plus approve or send back submitted sheets. Approving is what posts the stock entry to ERPNext.

roles.name: IT admin
roles.description: Everything, plus the worksheet editor, Settings and Requests.
